# Uzbekcha TTS

> Free Uzbek Text-to-Speech — Natural Uzbek AI Voice Generator

## What is Uzbekcha TTS?

Uzbekcha TTS is a free online service that converts Uzbek text into natural-sounding speech using AI neural voices. It generates downloadable MP3 audio files.

## Quick Start

Generate Uzbek speech:
GET https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/tts.mp3?q=Salom

## API Endpoints

- GET /tts.mp3?q=TEXT — Returns MP3 audio
- POST /api/tts — Generate audio (JSON body: {"text": "...", "voice": "uz-UZ-SardorNeural"})
- GET /api/voices — List available voices
- GET /api/info — Service metadata

## Available Uzbek Voices

- uz-UZ-SardorNeural (Sardor, male)
- uz-UZ-MadinaNeural (Madina, female)

## Documentation

- Full API docs: https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/guide
- AI integration guide: see llms-full.txt
- GitHub: https://github.com/developer-uzbek/tts-uzbek
